statements.status_notes: Three patches applied from Debian 3.21.12-15 (CVE-2025-4565-1 through CVE-2025-4565-3). Fixes denial of service in the Pure-Python protobuf backend when parsing untrusted input.
Five patches applied from Debian 3.21.12-15 (CVE-2024-7254-1 through CVE-2024-7254-5). Adds recursion depth limits when parsing nested Protocol Buffer messages to prevent stack overflow.
